title: Super-hot rock geothermal could end data center energy woes
summary: New geothermal startups are betting that they can leapfrog today's leaders to deliver terawatts of electricity nearly anywhere.
llm_summary: New geothermal ventures are developing “super‑hot rock” technology that can tap the Earth’s deep heat to generate electricity at terawatt scales, potentially anywhere in the world. By drilling into extremely hot, dry rock formations and circulating water to capture that heat, these startups aim to provide a clean, reliable power source that could finally solve the massive energy demands of modern data centers.
